# Course resources {.unnumbered}

Assignments, slides, readings, and quizzes are on **Canvas**, and announcements and discussion are on **Microsoft Teams** ([GEOG 370 Fall GIS (Parr)](https://teams.microsoft.com/l/team/19%3Au9zP0UQ6lk-iWqMzi2dE7ymggciXKTGAcz3dlsQG9J41%40thread.tacv2/conversations?groupId=6092ac8f-30ae-4968-89da-9061ae5e524c&tenantId=58b3d54f-16c9-42d3-af08-1fcabd095666)). This page collects the course staff, the class schedule, and assignment deadlines in one place. Dates are subject to change; changes are announced in class, on Canvas, and on Teams.
